data.action: 手持透明雨伞微微向身侧倾斜，清亮蓝眸凝视镜头
data.camera: medium two-shot, clear umbrella tilted toward a companion on a rainy train platform
data.description: 【艾莉 · 雨后车站·共撑一把伞】放学后的车站前飘着淅淅沥沥的细雨，艾莉撑开一把透明雨伞，将伞面不动声色地大半倾斜到你的头顶。她仰起清澈蔚蓝的眼眸，耳根微红地别开视线——「看在你没带伞的份上才顺路捎你一段。靠近一点，肩膀要是淋湿了我可不管。」
data.lighting: cool overcast rainy lighting, wet pavement reflections
data.promptProse: On the rainy station platform after school, Alya tilts a transparent umbrella farther over her companion, leaving herself near its outer edge. Her brown school blazer and blue skirt remain beside the second figure in a medium two-shot. Platform paving runs toward the tracks behind them. Cool overcast light catches raindrops across the canopy and pale hair, with soft reflections beneath both pairs of feet.
data.title: 艾莉莎·米哈伊洛夫娜·九条 · 雨后车站·共撑一把伞
